title: Southwire Recalls Globe and Snow Globe Stake Lights Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Light refraction through the stake lights can singe or melt items in contact with or in the immediate proximity, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 8,700 (in addition, about 10,000 units were sold in Canada).

title: Target Recalls Room Essentials 4-Drawer Dressers Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. Units: About 175,000 (in addition, about 3,000 units were sold in Canada).

title: Nantucket Distributing Recalls Patio Set Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The fabric seat on the chairs can tear, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 45,200 chairs.

title: L.L. Bean Recalls Toddler Sweater Fleece Pullovers Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The snaps on the fleece pullovers can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 2,000.

title: Smith Recalls Ski and Snowboard Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The buckle on the helmet can disengage, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 7,000 (in addition, about 1,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Studio Fun International Recalls Slap Bracelets Sold with Children's Storybooks Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The metal band can wear through the fabric covering of the slap bracelet, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 79,000 (in addition, about 7,000 were sold in Canada).

summary: The fuel tap or carburetor can leak fuel, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 20,000.

summary: The transmission gear can break, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: 5700.

summary: The children's nightgowns and pajama sets fail to meet flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 950.

summary: The soother's USB wall power adapter can break, posing an electrical shock hazard. Units: About 130,000 (In addition, about 21,500 were sold in Canada).

title: DICK'S Sporting Goods Recalls Resistance Tubes Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The resistance tubes can break while in use and strike the user, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 207,500.

summary: The grills' LP regulator can allow gas to flow at a higher pressure than intended, which can result in a gas leak and flame burst from the burner knobs, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. title: Delta Recalls Strollers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The stroller leg bracket can break, posing a fall hazard to infants in the stroller. Units: About 28,000.

title: Pro-Tec Recalls Multisport Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The buckle on the helmet fails to meet current federal safety standards, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 4,600.

title: Renthal Recalls Motorcycle Clip-on Handlebars Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The handlebar clamp can crack and fail, posing a crash hazard. Units: 3000.

title: DEMDACO Recalls Infant Bib and Bootie Sets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Rattles sewn into the booties can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 1,500.

summary: The lit firework can tip over and fire shells at bystanders, posing burn, fire and impact hazards to consumers. Units: About 13,050.

summary: The transmission can fail, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 25,000 tractors and 500 transmissions sold as service parts (in addition, about 1,200 were sold in Canada).
